publicationStmt.p: Tag layer of the DHSS Meta-Tagging Project. The article text is reproduced from the staged copy named in sourceDesc and is not altered; the tags are held separately in standOff so that overlapping and nested spans are preserved.

bibl.title: Solving the global STEM educational crisis using Cognitive Load Optimization and Artificial Intelligence–A preliminary comparative analysis
bibl.publisher: Eurasia Journal of Mathematics, Science and Technology Education

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: method
span.quote: CLO, a new SoL theory, is fundamentally different because it is based on quantitatively modeling relational knowledge (and extended abstract knowledge) as a coherent, contiguous whole that is pedagogically scalable across different educational sectors.

span.label: cognitive load in STEM instructional materials
span.quote: This preliminary evaluation seeks to explore the effectiveness of implementing artificial intelligence (AI) and cognitive load optimization (CLO) in STEM education.

span.label: review
span.quote: The author further stated that new data presented in this paper stems from an analysis of printed materials only.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: short-term (working) memory has limited capacity, so high-intrinsic-load material overloads it and blocks schema construction in long-term memory
span.quote: However, STM (aka working memory) has only limited capacity and retention time and hence can easily be overloaded by curriculum materials with a high ICL.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: cognitive gaps in the material raise cognitive load, students fill the gaps with their own incorrect conclusions, and the resulting misconceptions then handicap further learning
span.quote: This problem is compounded by cognitive gaps in the materials, which exacerbate the cognitive load and may result in students coming to their own incorrect conclusions called misconceptions, which may handicap further learning.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: because existing learning theories are qualitative and open to interpretation, material quality tracks the individual educator's skill, which produces wide variation in pedagogical quality and pass rates
span.quote: Current learning theories and methods are easy to use and well established but are based on qualitative soft science principles, with subjective guidelines that are open to interpretation and hence dependent on the skill and experience of the educator.

span.label: CLO is time consuming to implement, which the author offers economies of scale to offset.
span.quote: However, CLO is time consuming to implement.

span.label: The effect of ChatGPT on learning outcomes was not determined by this study.
span.quote: Further work is needed to determine AI ChatGPT’s impact on learning outcomes.

span.label: The new data in the paper come only from analysis of printed materials, not from a new controlled study.
span.quote: The author further stated that new data presented in this paper stems from an analysis of printed materials only.

span.label: CLO is a detailed methodology that is time consuming to implement
span.quote: However, CLO is time consuming to implement.

span.label: CLO is new and its detailed procedures and metrics must be learned before use, which costs time
span.quote: However, CLO is a new learning theory with a detailed methodology (procedures, metrics etc.) that is time consuming to use.

span.label: The effect of ChatGPT on learning outcomes is not established by this study
span.quote: Further work is needed to determine AI ChatGPT’s impact on learning outcomes.

span.label: Only text-based ChatGPT is considered
span.quote: This paper is restricted to text-based ChatGPT.

span.label: The evidence offered for the method is one cohort given three lectures, and the cohort is described as students whose first language was not English.
span.quote: In this experiment, a cohort of 33 students whose first language was not English were given three lectures in remote online mode on computer technology, network technology and cybersecurity using CLO based materials and the relative advantages of CLO versus traditional teaching evaluated.

span.label: The AI half of the proposal is repeatedly marked as not yet established, in the same table that presents the framework.
span.quote: AI ChatGPT is applicable to school, college, and university educational sectors, but is not necessarily coherent and contiguous. Further work is needed. the output 10. Instructional design: CLO schemas serve as the basis of curriculum design, teaching, and assessment. Further work is needed regarding the role of AI ChatGPT in instructional design and assessment.

span.label: Its effect on the outcome the paper cares about is explicitly still open.
span.quote: Further work is needed to determine AI ChatGPT’s impact on learning outcomes.

span.label: The comparison class is characterised rather than measured: existing theories are described as qualitative and subjective, and the description is the ground for replacing them.
span.quote: These theories and methods are easy to use and well established but are based on qualitative soft science principles, with subjective guidelines that are open to interpretation and hence dependent on the skill and experience of the educator.

span.label: The internalisation mechanism the framework depends on is supported only as 'some evidence', with further work stated as needed.
span.quote: There is some evidence that during the teaching and learning process these CLO schema diagrams are internalized into students’ LTM, which may facilitate scaffolding in which more complex knowledge is contextualized and acquired.

span.label: the design of instructional material is recast as a combinatorial optimization problem — identifying, ranking and sequentially ordering interdependent elements to minimise a measured cost function (cognitive load)
span.quote: Optimization is essential because creating coherent and contiguous relational knowledge is a complex combinatorial problem involving the identification, ranking, and sequential ordering of many interdependent elements and associated relationships.

span.label: cognitive load optimization
span.quote: CLO is a new science of learning (SoL) theory that quantitatively models relational knowledge as coherent, contiguous, pedagogically scalable schemas optimized for the lowest cognitive load.

span.label: science of learning
span.quote: CLO is a new science of learning (SoL) theory that quantitatively models relational knowledge as coherent, contiguous, pedagogically scalable schemas

span.label: SOLO taxonomy
span.quote: Learning outcomes can be evaluated by a learning taxonomy such as the Structure of Observed Learning Outcomes (SOLO) taxonomy (Biggs & Collis, 1982, 1989).

span.label: cognitive load optimization - claimed as a QUANTITATIVE science-of-learning theory, defined by modelling relational knowledge as schemas optimised for the lowest cognitive load
span.quote: CLO is a new science of learning (SoL) theory that quantitatively models relational knowledge as coherent, contiguous, pedagogically scalable schemas optimized for the lowest cognitive load.

span.label: learning theory - the paper draws a line ChatGPT is placed on the far side of: a useful pedagogical tool, but not a learning theory
span.quote: Arguable it is a useful pedagogical tool but not a learning theory.

span.label: existing learning theories - characterised as qualitative soft-science principles with subjective guidelines open to interpretation, which is the stated ground for a quantitative replacement
span.quote: The current learning theories in use today are based on qualitative soft-science principles, with subjective guidelines that are open to interpretation, which can lead to wide variations in the quality of instructional materials and learning outcomes.

span.label: extends → Cognitive Load Theory (CLT); de Jong, 2010
span.quote: However, CLT lacks a reliable quantitative metric for measuring ICL (de Jong, 2010).

span.label: extends → Cognitive Load Theory (CLT), de Jong 2010
span.quote: However, CLT lacks a reliable quantitative metric for measuring ICL (de Jong, 2010).

span.label: contradicts → Constructivist learning theory
span.quote: In effect students are guided to construct their own knowledge–which may be inefficient and error prone.

span.label: builds-on → SOLO taxonomy (Biggs & Collis, 1982, 1989)
span.quote: Learning outcomes can be evaluated by a learning taxonomy such as the Structure of Observed Learning Outcomes (SOLO) taxonomy (Biggs & Collis, 1982, 1989).

span.label: cognitive load optimization —is-a→ science of learning
span.quote: CLO is a new science of learning (SoL) theory that quantitatively models relational knowledge as coherent, contiguous, pedagogically scalable schemas

span.label: descriptive statistics
span.quote: A cohort of 30 Chinese business studies graduate students were taught IT based on CLO principles in remote online mode and the results evaluated using descriptive statistics factors that included: Performance Anticipation (PA), Effort Expectancy (EE), Relative Benefit (RB), and Adopt Cognitive Load (ACL).

span.label: mean
span.quote: had a mean of 4.09 with a standard deviation of 0.739 (Nuangjamnong, 2023).

span.label: standard deviation
span.quote: had a mean of 4.09 with a standard deviation of 0.739 (Nuangjamnong, 2023).

span.label: ChatGPT 3.5's explanation of hubs versus switches omitted the prerequisite (Ethernet), left medium access control, collision domains, dedicated bandwidth and segmentation undefined, and misused 'data packets' and 'broadcast', producing material with high cognitive load and gaps that risk misconceptions.
span.quote: The overall output imposes a high cognitive load with cognitive gaps, posing a risk of student misconceptions.

span.label: On the two sine equations ChatGPT produced a coherent, teachable explanation, but silently mixed degrees in one equation with radians in the other.
span.quote: However, a notable inconsistency is identified concerning the use of degrees in Eq. (1) and radians in Eq. (2), posing a potential source of confusion that requires clarification.

span.label: Every STEM curriculum item examined across school, college and university level was non-sequential and contained cognitive gaps, i.e. carried a high cognitive load.
span.quote: All the materials were, to various degrees, incoherent and discontinuous i.e., non-sequential with cognitive gaps representative of a high cognitive load.

span.label: Sixty-four business students who had already passed three STEM IT units answered ten simple relational-knowledge questions and every one of them scored zero, indicating their passes carried no relational understanding.
span.quote: The quality of learning of 64 undergraduate Business studies students who had passed three STEM IT units was evaluated by ten simple relational knowledge questions–all students scored zero (Maj & Nuangjamnong, 2020).

span.label: Across school, certificate, diploma, undergraduate and postgraduate STEM teaching, in both face-to-face and remote modes, CLO produced pass and retention rates of typically 100% together with very positive student satisfaction.
span.quote: In all cases CLO consistently achieved high pass and retention rates (typically 100%) coupled with exceptionally high positive student satisfaction feedback (Maj, 2022).

span.label: Cognitive Load Theory cannot deliver the 'optimized learning' goals because it has no reliable quantitative measure of intrinsic cognitive load, and optimization is by definition a quantitative method.
span.quote: However, CLT lacks a reliable quantitative metric for measuring ICL (de Jong, 2010).

span.label: Ninety-nine percent of the students in the comparison preferred CLO-based learning over the standard method.
span.quote: The majority of students (99%) preferred learning based on the CLO method.

span.label: ChatGPT works across STEM disciplines and levels but is an educational technology rather than a learning theory, and gives no assurance of pedagogical quality.
span.quote: ChatGPT is easy to use and works for a wide range of STEM disciplines and educational levels but there are two potential problems– it is an educational technology but arguably not an educational theory and there is no assurance of pedagogical quality.

span.label: Cognitive Load Optimization (CLO)
span.quote: CLO is a new science of learning (SoL) theory that quantitatively models relational knowledge as coherent, contiguous, pedagogically scalable schemas optimized for the lowest cognitive load.

span.label: Cognitive Load Theory (CLT)
span.quote: Cognitive Load Theory (CLT) is based on cognitive science principles that include schema, Short-Term Memory (STM), Long-Term Memory (LTM), and Intrinsic Cognitive Load (ICL) (Bannert, 2002; Valcke, 2002).

span.label: intrinsic cognitive load (ICL)
span.quote: ICL represents the complexity of the knowledge to be taught.

span.label: schema
span.quote: Knowledge is represented as a schema, a pattern of relationships between elements, stored in LTM.

span.label: relational knowledge (high order learning)
span.quote: High order learning is relational knowledge with many interdependent elements and extended abstract in which knowledge can be generalized to a new subject.

span.label: misconceptions
span.quote: Cognitive gaps not only exacerbate the cognitive load but may result in students coming to their own incorrect conclusions called misconceptions.

span.label: the CLO cognitive-load metric
span.quote: The simplest metric involves dividing the number of concepts by attribute changes, forming the basis for quantitative optimization achievable either manually or through a software tool based on optmization principles.

span.label: SOLO taxonomy
span.quote: Learning outcomes can be evaluated by a learning taxonomy such as the Structure of Observed Learning Outcomes (SOLO) taxonomy (Biggs & Collis, 1982, 1989).

span.label: teaching method (CLO-based materials vs traditional teaching)
span.term: teaching method (CLO-based materials vs traditional teaching)
span.quote: In this experiment, a cohort of 33 students whose first language was not English were given three lectures in remote online mode on computer technology, network technology and cybersecurity using CLO based materials and the relative advantages of CLO versus traditional teaching evaluated.

span.label: order/quality of learning outcome on the SOLO taxonomy
span.term: order/quality of learning outcome on the SOLO taxonomy
span.quote: The results indicated that learning based on the standard method was superficial low order (SOLO multi-structural with understanding based on several related elements with metrics such as ‘list’ or ‘describe’) that is unlikely to be resident in LTM.

span.label: pass and retention rates
span.quote: In all cases CLO consistently achieved high pass and retention rates (typically 100%) coupled with exceptionally high positive student satisfaction feedback (Maj, 2022).

span.label: 99% — share of students preferring CLO-based learning to the standard method
span.quote: The majority of students (99%) preferred learning based on the CLO method.

span.label: 64 ... zero — business students tested on ten relational-knowledge questions after passing three STEM IT units, and their score
span.quote: The quality of learning of 64 undergraduate Business studies students who had passed three STEM IT units was evaluated by ten simple relational knowledge questions–all students scored zero (Maj & Nuangjamnong, 2020).

span.label: 100% — pass and retention rates for engineering mathematics taught by the CLO method in remote access mode
span.quote: Teaching engineering mathematics based on the CLO method in remote access mode resulted in excellent student feedback, 100% pass and retention rates whilst still achieving the learning objectives (Maj, 2018).

span.label: mean of 4.09 with a standard deviation of 0.739 — rating of the Relative Benefit factor by the Chinese graduate-student cohort taught with CLO
span.quote: had a mean of 4.09 with a standard deviation of 0.739 (Nuangjamnong, 2023).

span.label: 210 — business studies graduate students whose behavioural intention to adopt CLO was evaluated with TAM and UTAUT
span.quote: The behavioral intentions of a cohort of 210 business studies graduate students, evaluated by both the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT), found a significant effect on students’ behavioral intention to adopt/use CLO (Nuangjamnong, 2022).

span.label: 29% ... 34% — respondents in a national online-learning report complaining of lack of engagement, and of inadequate academic interaction
span.quote: According to a national report on online learning 29% of respondents complained about lack of engagement and 34% complained about lack of/inadequate academic interaction.

span.label: one million — additional STEM graduates called for by the US President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
span.quote: The STEM educational crisis is underscored by the report of the US President’s Council of Advisors on Science and Technology that emphasized the imperative for an additional one million STEM graduates and a substantial enhancement in retention rates (PCAST, 2012).

span.label: 33 — non-native-English students taught three remote lectures with CLO materials in the reported experiment
span.quote: In this experiment, a cohort of 33 students whose first language was not English were given three lectures in remote online mode on computer technology, network technology and cybersecurity using CLO based materials and the relative advantages of CLO versus traditional teaching evaluated.
